versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

- Clarified workflow: lyrics organization now stops before song generation unless explicitly requested; no Suno account login is performed.
- Section labeling and structure are emphasized as required before paid generation on Beatra.
- Updated instruction to separate lyric skeleton confirmation from full song-generation confirmation, reducing unnecessary regenerations.
- Improved separation between arrangement (free) and paid music generation steps for better user clarity.
- Removed the unnecessary skill-card.md file for improved package maintenance.
Publish the reviewed Suno Lyrics to Song workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
